decision.scope: One corrected literal Git-blob diagnostic control on the already built f0 hosted native and one fresh verified-unused root, with identities kept separate.

conclusions: Changed selector reads actual live roster state and existing C-guarded weapon-package information, without entity placement, physics, precision-rule or launch-implementation changes. It constructs neighboring spatial cells, orders candidate pairs by 3D distance then deterministic roster tie order, and skips launchers without a qualifying stock weapon.

Target side is explicitly a controlled test precondition rather than campaign targeting policy. The existing real launch call still establishes/restores its temporary target link, and the previously closed report/restoration and checked-output/poison guards are retained.

Current source wn_flight.c2541..2639 confirms that high precision and an entity-collision MISS gate the TREE lookup. Nearness is measured between launcher and target at selection; it does not prove the weapon NEW position will be within range or that entity collision will miss. Both script and document acknowledge this; actual contact_trees_tests and provider counters remain decisive.

No available near armed pair produces named setup failure. A completed projectile cohort with zero TREE calls remains UNREACHED, not authority or Original capability evidence. Same selector is used in hosted and Original profiles; no forced precision, fake miss or Core solver fallback is introduced.

The spatial-cell approach retains all nearby candidate pairs; it is not a universal constant-memory or worst-case nonquadratic guarantee for arbitrary dense rosters. This does not change the finite source-safety decision for the declared retail diagnostic; failed setup/processing never becomes a pass.
